A '''cafe''', alse spelled '''café''', was a type of [[Restaurant/Legends|dining establishment]]. The [[Meltdown Café]] was located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="de">[[Dark Empire II 2|''Dark Empire II'' 2]]</ref> and [[Doodnik's Café]] was located on [[Tyne's Horky]].
